integrity: The general theorem is proved in RESULT.md. VERIFY.py and VERIFY_OUTPUT.txt document independent finite-case computations and are not treated as proof of the infinite family. Closest historical statements and residual literature-access risks are reported in REVIEW.md and AUDIT.json.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to synchronous GF(2) neighbor parity dynamics on standard Boolean cubes with exactly one vertex including its own state. It does not classify nonlinear local rules or multiple defects; geometric orbit quotients are not counted. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: A one-site feedback defect creates periods three and six on Boolean hypercubes
